singleOutcome: Ordinary-member desktop/mobile edit, single-flight autosave, server recovery and recoverable CAS conflict UI.

behavior: three-second idle and blur autosave for DRAFT
one request in flight with latest pending snapshot coalescing
manual DRAFT and ACTIVE save through the same coordinator
server URL recovery after refresh and backend restart
local input retention on failure with retry
structured CAS conflict reload or copy-as-new-draft
contract.completionBoundary: P4-B1 editing and autosave only; archive, discard, expiry recovery and my-drafts belong to P4-B2.

ui.coordinatorAssertion: only first and latest snapshots execute; maximum in-flight requests is one

assertions: first DRAFT normalizes to the edit URL
three-second and blur saves persist after refresh
delayed save coalesces later input without overlap
forced 503 retains local input and retry succeeds
two stale saves expose server snapshot and reload/copy choices
copied DRAFT activates and ACTIVE edit survives reload

resolvedFindings.finding: Ant Design retains off-screen drawer DOM during transitions, so a global strict title locator produced false failures.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Browser assertions now target the semantic title/detail content rather than animation containers.

resolvedFindings.finding: The first cleanup implementation deleted child rows before checking whether a copied record had become ACTIVE.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Child-row cleanup now joins a DRAFT record predicate; polluted P4-B1 test rows were removed and one complete acceptance record was recreated and verified.

resolvedFindings.finding: VS3 regression still expected the pre-P4 placeholder that said the module structure was ready.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Regression assertions now require the real record workbench empty state delivered by P4-A1.
